name: Phantom Spires parking area at the end of the gravel road off Wrights Lake Road
basis: Mountain Project Phantom Spires page and other guide pages: Wrights Lake Road ~2.2 mi from Hwy 50, left on unpaved logging road 11N26B for about half a mile to the parking area (room for a few cars), no day-use fee. The brief's lot w430242542 is mapped as 'Phantom Spires Parking Area' and sits ~0.2 km from the spires' coordinate.

name: Pyramid Creek / Horsetail Falls trailhead lot off Highway 50 (day-use fee)
basis: Mountain Project Pyramid Creek / Horsetail Falls page: parking lot on the left off Hwy 50 for the Horsetail Falls trailhead, Gemini Boulders reached by the Horsetail Falls trail; Forest Service trailhead page: $10 day-use fee, north side of Hwy 50 near Twin Bridges. Matched by position to the mapped fee-charging lot beside the mapped 'Pyramid Creek Trailhead' node (~15 m apart).
